limits: Three sequential audit samples and two live origin samples are not p95 or a load test.
An in-process audit uses the deployed code but a separate Flask process and root socket DB connection with transaction_read_only=1; no account passwords or response bodies are retained.
First audit session includes process-lazy initialization; live serving session was 8-15 ms.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes SELECT and adds instrumentation overhead; its nested times must not be added together.
I/O deltas are global and can include other MySQL traffic; no controlled empty or cold buffer pool was created.
Journal records completion timestamps, without request start/duration, so 14.473 seconds is not an exact API duration.
No authenticated cold browser navigation, DOM/paint profile, client network trace, or controlled before/after deployment comparison was captured.
Origin JSON had no gzip; public Cloudflare responses can gzip, so origin body size is not assumed to equal browser wire bytes.
The October 4 baseline used different code and a smaller presentation population; it is historical context, not proof of a like-for-like regression.
